results.title: Watch: Mumbai: Massive fire engulfs shops and hutments in Dongri
results.content: A major fire broke out at Haji Kasam Chawl in Mumbai’s Dongri area late on Sunday, November 8, engulfing several shops and hutments. Firefighting operations were launched to bring the blaze under control. Two other fire incidents were reported in Dadar and Andheri over the weekend, with one person killed in the Andheri blaze.
